text: A statement of retained earnings presents an analysis of the Retained Earnings account for a given accounting period. An example of a statement of retained earnings is presented in Exhibit 10-3. The statement begins with the retained earnings balance as of the beginning of the period @, then reports the items that caused retained earnings to change during the period @, and ends with the end-of-period balance in retained earnings €.
